title: Almaty and Baku with the Tufandag Cable Car
alt: Tufandag cable car rising over the forests above Gabala
transport: Private transfers, guided day tours and an internal flight

stops.name: Almaty
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Well run hotel in the centre with a garden courtyard

activities.name: Almaty city sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided tour of the old capital, taking in the Monument of Independence, Panfilov Park and the wooden Ascension Cathedral.

activities.name: Medeu rink and Shymbulak ski resort
activities.match: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort
activities.description: A day up the Malaya Almatinka valley to the Olympic skating rink at Medeu, then by gondola to the Shymbulak slopes.

activities.name: Green Bazaar and the Rakhat chocolate factory
activities.match: Trip to Green Bazaar & Rakhat Chocolate Factory, Almaty
activities.description: The spice and dried fruit halls of the Green Bazaar, then the Rakhat factory whose chocolate every Kazakh family grew up on.

program.name: Almaty
program.description: Four nights in the old Kazakh capital with the city tour, the Shymbulak gondola and the Green Bazaar.

stops.name: Baku
stops.subtitle: Baku → Gabala and Absheron
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Friendly hotel close to the walled Old City

activities.name: Baku Old City tour
activities.description: The walled Icherisheher with the Maiden Tower, the Shirvanshahs' palace, Fountain Square and the boating canals on the boulevard.

activities.name: Gabala and Tufandag mountain
activities.match: Day Trip to Gabala and Tufandag Mountain from Baku
activities.description: A day northwest to Nohur lake with its drowned trees, then the Tufandag cable car up into the Greater Caucasus.

activities.name: Absheron peninsula tour
activities.description: The Ateshgah fire temple, the Mardakan castle and Yanar Dagh, a hillside where escaping gas has burned for centuries.

program.name: Baku
program.description: Four nights on the Caspian with the walled Old City, a day in the Caucasus foothills and the fire temples of Absheron.

1: Arrival at Almaty International and transfer to your hotel
Check in and the rest of the day free
Optional: the stalls of the Zelyony bazaar
Optional: an evening on Abai Square
2: Breakfast, then a guided tour of the city
The Monument of Independence on Republic Square
Panfilov Park and the wooden Ascension Cathedral
3: Breakfast, then up the Malaya Almatinka valley
The Medeu dam and its Olympic skating rink
On by gondola to the Shymbulak ski resort
Snow peaks of the Zailiysky Alatau above you
4: Breakfast, then into the Green Bazaar halls
Horse meat counters, dried fruit and spice stalls
The Rakhat chocolate factory and its shop
Optional: the Kok Tobe cable car at dusk
5: Breakfast and check out of your Almaty hotel
Optional: flight Almaty to Baku, booked with us
Arrival transfer from Heydar Aliyev to your hotel
Optional: the seaside national park and the Baku Eye
6: Breakfast, then into the walled Old City
The Maiden Tower and the Shirvanshahs' palace
Fountain Square and the boating canals on the boulevard
Afternoon free on the seafront boulevard
7: Early breakfast and northwest into the foothills
Nohur lake with its drowned trees
The Tufandag cable car above Gabala
Evening transfer back along the coast to Baku
8: Breakfast, then out onto the Absheron peninsula
The Ateshgah fire temple and its stone courtyard
Yanar Dagh, the hillside that has burned for centuries
Mardakan castle and the Heydar Aliyev Centre
9: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Heydar Aliyev for your flight home

expert.name: Aisha
expert.quote: The extra night in Baku is what makes this one work. Old City, Caucasus and Absheron each get their own day instead of being doubled up.
expert.tip: Yanar Dagh is best at dusk, when the flames actually show against the dark. Ask your driver to make it the last stop of day eight.

summary: Nine days across the Caspian with daily breakfast: Almaty with its city tour, the Shymbulak gondola and the Green Bazaar, then four nights in Baku for the Old City, the Tufandag cable car and the Absheron fire temples.
included: Included: 4 nights in Almaty and 4 nights in Baku with daily breakfast; private airport transfers in both cities; Almaty city sightseeing tour; day trip to the Medeu rink and Shymbulak ski resort; Green Bazaar and Rakhat chocolate factory trip; Baku Old City tour; Gabala and Tufandag mountain day trip; Absheron peninsula tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Almaty to Baku internal flight; Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan visa fees; lunches and dinners; personal expenses.
